branching: criterion F applies only if autism/childhood communication disorder present; otherwise A-E sequence
completeness_rule: statuses unanswered/partial/complete/bypassed plus per-field unknown; bypass allowed without reason; actor/time recorded at runtime, not in definition

definition_proposal.criterion_a: >=2 of 5 domains (delusions, hallucinations, disorganized speech, disorganized/catatonic behavior, negative symptoms) in same active-phase 1-month interval; >=1 of delusions/hallucinations/disorganized speech; interval may be shorter if effective intervention abbreviates it
definition_proposal.criterion_b: function clearly below prior level in >=1 major area (work, education, relationships, self-care) for a meaningful portion; pre-adult onset: failure to reach expected level
definition_proposal.criterion_c: >=6 months continuous illness incl >=1 month active-phase A (unless abbreviated); remainder prodromal, residual, or additional active; prodromal/residual may be negative symptoms alone or >=2 attenuated A symptoms
definition_proposal.criterion_d: no major depressive/manic episode with active psychosis, or mood episodes occupy only a minority of total active+residual course; needs longitudinal timeline
definition_proposal.criterion_e: not better explained by substance, medication, toxin, withdrawal, or medical/neurological cause; judge by timing vs exposure and course after cause resolves
definition_proposal.criterion_f: if autism/childhood communication disorder present: add schizophrenia only with prominent delusions/hallucinations plus other required features for >=1 month (unless abbreviated)

independent_examples.expected: review candidate (proposed, not approved) — meets A-F on paper, pending review
independent_examples.inputs: delusions + hallucinations in same 1-month active phase; work decline; 7-month continuous course; no concurrent mood episode; no substance/medical cause; no autism history
independent_examples.name: qualifying full A-F case

independent_examples.expected: must NOT satisfy — symptom count alone cannot meet criteria
independent_examples.inputs: 2 symptom domains present but in different intervals with no shared 1-month active phase
independent_examples.name: symptom-count-only case
